newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says wins order from Japan.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says wins order from Japan.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Tuesday it won a $40 million order from Digital Tu-Ka Hokkaido (DTD) to expand a Pacific Digital Cellular (PDC) mobile telephone system.
The order includes AXE switching and radio base station equipment which will be ready for use in autumn 1997, Ericsson said in a statement.
"The expansion will extend DTD's coverage area and increase system capacity to meet the rapid subscriber growth in the Hokkaido region," Ericsson said.

It said that Japan was one of the fastest growing cellular markets in the world and the number of subscribers, which is 21 million currently, would rise to 53 million by the turn of the century. Most would be using digital systems, it said.
